title: Something About You
description:
Because of a difficult family background, Ji-U enters college later than most of her peers. Quiet and reserved, she keeps to the edges of campus life, always feeling one step out of sync with everyone else. There is one person she cannot help noticing, U-Yeon, a boy who seems to shine wherever he goes. He stands at the center of every group, laughing easily, drawing people in without effort. Compared to him, Ji-U feels invisible, and so she hides her feelings, nursing a silent crush she believes will never reach him. To Ji-U, U-Yeon appears flawless, someone untouched by hardship or pain. But one rainy day, that illusion shatters. Ji-U stumbles upon U-Yeon standing alone in the downpour, tears mixing with rain as he cries with heartbreaking beauty. In that moment, Ji-U realizes that even the brightest people carry unseen scars. And perhaps her quiet presence could become a place of comfort for him.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title: The Ex-orcist
description:
Once sorta passionate lovers, Ha-Sol and Jin-Yul are now nothing more than each other's "exes." After completing his mandatory military service and returning to university, Jin-Yul unexpectedly crosses paths with Ha-Sol on campus. Uncomfortable with the awkward baggage of their shared history, Jin-Yul does everything in his power to avoid his former flame. However, destiny takes a bizarre and terrifying turn when a malicious ghost—one that had been relentlessly stalking Jin-Yul—takes complete possession of Ha-Sol's body. 

Driven by the spirit's dark, uninhibited desires, the boundary between the supernatural and the carnal quickly dissolves. Trapped together by this paranormal anomaly, the former couple finds themselves pushed into an intense, feverish intimacy, crossing boundaries and indulging in raw, physical acts they never even dared to attempt back when they were actually dating. Their unresolved past colliding with possession sparks an uncontrollable, forbidden fire between them.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Winter Field
description:
At the edge of a distant continent, a land perpetually blanketed in snow lies Oldenland, ruled by Archduke Giesel Zvendard. His cold demeanor, overwhelming magical prowess, and even the bizarre rumor that he carries the blood of monsters make everyone fear him. Yet few know that what Giesel truly desires is simply a peaceful daily life, immersed in magical research with a warm cup of tea in his quiet study. What shattered this modest wish was an unexpected bride from the southernmost tip of Cornia. Rensley Mallosen, the bastard son of Cornia, appeared wearing a bride's crown in place of his runaway sister. His brief attempt to hide, fearing discovery, was short-lived. This cheerful, chatty knight, his sun-like golden hair flowing as he roamed the castle, kept stirring up small disturbances in the ice castle that seemed destined for eternal silence. Even though he should have been driven out immediately for this fraudulent marriage, Giesel found himself increasingly unable to look away from Rensley, who beamed brightly and chattered away at even the smallest kindness. Rensley, who had been rejected from the moment he was born and ultimately abandoned, arriving in Oldenland, began to harbor affection for Giesel's seemingly indifferent yet kind demeanor. But the moment he became aware of his feelings, the time for parting drew near...

To Oldenland, the coldest land on the continent, yet where the warmest things gather, will Rensley ever be able to return?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: Love Order
description:
Born gay, born single Kang Woo-Jin. He's been secretly in love with Choi Yi-Tae, the transfer student he met in his second year of high school, all the way to his current age of thirty. Kang Woo-Jin couldn't betray the friendship he shared with Choi Yi-Tae during their youthful days, convincing himself it was okay to remain just friends. But when Choi Yi-Tae starts pestering him to move in together, Kang Woo-Jin finds himself facing an unavoidable dilemma.

 *“I'm gay.”

“What does you being gay have to do with us living together?”*

Dragged into cohabitation, Kang Woo-Jin begins living with him. Months later, an incident finally pushes him past the line of friendship.

 *“Kang Woo-Jin, how do you have sex with a guy?”*

There was no way he knew. He'd tried with other men, but never followed through. He could only think of this guy right in front of him. It had been 13 years of unrequited love. Now that we've crossed the line of friendship, what exactly are we?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

description:
The cherished youngest daughter of the prestigious Jujak clan, Jeok Soya, is suddenly exposed as a fake.

“Strip her of her spirit core and lock her in the Cold Palace.”

Though her heart ached from her family’s cruelty and cold rejection, she endured it.
After all, she was just a wicked little fledgling who had deceived them and brought them sorrow.

“Please… get rid of that child.”

But even so, accepting death was a different matter entirely.

“What is this… little fluff ball?”

At the brink of danger, the one who saves Soya is a ferocious tiger—
No… the head of the Baekho clan.

“I think I’ll steal you, little fluff.”

Accepting his suspicious offer, Soya follows him to the land of Baekho.
She plans to live quietly, never drawing attention… but something about this clan is strange.

“Don’t worry, you’re no trouble at all. Stay here as long as you like.”

The clan head, infamous for his brutality, is unexpectedly gentle.

“Try calling me ‘Oppa,’ Soya.”
“Me too! I’m your oppa now, fluff ball!”

The young masters of the Baekho clan compete to become her older brothers.
And strangest of all—

“Our little fluff lady is just too adorable!”
“Hmph! Bet your old house didn’t have a fluff this cute, huh?”

“…Me? Cute? Not useless and dreadful?”

title: Collage
description:
*In a season when cherry blossom petals scatter on the dry wind, I fell in love with a pale faced poet. My first experience of unrequited love was like a fever.
Each time I suffered from it, I caught my heated breath and quietly sank into misery. Yet that spring was undeniably the most lyrical season of my life.*

Baek Seonghyeon, a poor working student, returns to university with a completely ruined timetable after getting the course registration date wrong. Forced to attend even a literature class he has no interest in, he looks up the course withdrawal period and happens to notice a note taking job posting on campus. Twice a week, a monthly pay of 1.5 million won. Without a second thought, Baek Seonghyeon sends in his application.

Never once imagining that there, he would meet a poet who would completely upend his life.

title: Salt Society
description:
Alpha Jo Yeon-Oh, the extreme right-winger and heir to the Haesung Foundation, and Beta So Gi-Hyeon, his childhood friend who had long watched over him from the sidelines while nurturing his love alone. The seemingly solid bond between them begins to crack with Gi-Hyeon's confession. The moment he revealed his long-held affection, Yeon-Oh responded with an insulting, disgusted retort.

 *“You've forgotten you're a Beta, haven't you?”*

An Alpha who physiologically despises dating a Beta. Faced with this harsh, painful rebuke, Gi-Hyeon quietly tries to let go, but Yeon-Oh rejects even that. Jo Yeon-Oh, revealing his selfish obsession and controlling tendencies toward what he cherishes, refuses to allow Gi-Hyeon to distance himself.

 *“Fine. Let's do it. Dating. You fucking selfish bastard.”*

What he chose instead of severing ties was the start of a deceitful relationship. But since it was Yeon-Oh's choice too, Gi-Hyeon accepted it.

 *“If you really can't stand it, I said I'd find someone for you. Try to stick with omegas if possible.”*

Yeon-Oh's cruel consideration, suggesting sleep with others even while dating. Gi-Hyeon, whose heart was being indifferently carved up, also reaches his limit. Yet, at the end of his excruciating unrequited love, Gi-Hyeon faces a physical change he never believed possible. Jo Yeon-Oh, the possessive, twisted obsessive who denies his feelings, and Gi-Hyeon, who stoically swallowed his wounds until he finally chose to flee. Where will the diverging paths of these two ultimately lead?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*“I didn’t have any lingering regrets from my past life anyway, so whatever. Since it’s come to this, I might as well enjoy stanning my favorite to my heart’s content.”*

That was what I thought, but I survived because a power that never existed in the original story awakened within me. On top of that, somewhere along the way, I ended up winning over my in laws far too easily.

*“You are probably the only person who would risk their life for Akid’s favourably more than for a commission.”*

My free spirited, utterly dysfunctional father in law even helps support my fangirling.

*“Then you should not have been born so cute. There are plenty of vicious criminals in this world who prey on children as adorable as you.”*

My mother in law, once known as the Mad Dog of Heint, does not treat me coldly at all. Instead, she goes to extremes to protect me. And then there is my husband, who used to be nothing but innocent, suddenly starting to flirt with me at every opportunity.

*“Roena’s hair is just like cotton candy.”

“My hair is a bit frizzy, though.”

“Not at all. I meant it is so soft that I want to keep touching it.”*

All this time, I thought I was someone dangerous to him. But then…

*“Roena, do you have any idea now who is more dangerous?”*

Could it be that my Akid, whom I thought was only pure and naive, was actually a genius at flirting all along?

Her peaceful rest is violently shattered when the man sitting next to her, who had seemingly offered his shoulder for her to lean on, suddenly thrusts his middle finger deep into her private opening. Jolted awake and paralyzed by terror, she can barely squeeze out a desperate whisper: .

*"S-stop, please stop...".*

The predator only offers a cold, mocking smirk.

*"Stop what?".

"If you stop, I'll... I'll just pretend this never happened, aaah!"*.

Yegyeong gasps, her plea cut short as his touch grows even more invasive. To her absolute horror, the nightmare escalates. As she looks up through tears, she realizes that the crowd is shifting, and a group of completely unfamiliar men are slowly closing in, surrounding her seat to seal her fate.

The peace he struggled to protect is shattered in an instant.Vowing revenge, Theo reawakens the forbidden power he sealed away three decades ago to reclaim his daughter. Standing against Zero Core’s vast conspiracy and a world steeped in prejudice, the lonely battle of the last Ender begins.

description:

Mido is kidnapped to serve as a blood donor for a young master suffering from a rare condition. Bracing herself for a life of violation and suffering, she is instead met with a man who appears beautiful, gentle, and harmless.

“Mido, you are my only hope. I will treat you well, so would you like to stay by my side?” 

As Mido remains beside Baekgyung while searching for a chance to escape, the man behind the gentle façade begins to slowly and cunningly break down her defenses. Alarmed by her growing willingness to stay with someone she knows she should hate, Mido begins to push him away.

“An attitude befitting of our relationship. If that’s what you truly want, I can act like a kidnapper again.” 

A fierce battle of wills unfolds between one who clings and one who longs to be free. An unexpected incident leads Baekgyung to taste Mido’s blood, awakening a violent surge of the instability he had long suppressed.

“In cases of extreme compatibility, did you know bodily fluids can have an aphrodisiac effect?” 

“Aphrodisiac effect?” 

“It means that whether it’s your saliva or your body, it affects me the same way your blood does.” 

As their relationship takes an unexpected turn, Baekgyung’s obsession with Mido ignites. Yet Mido has her own reason for needing to return…

Will Mido ever be able to escape from this beautiful madman?

description:
Demian, a boy raised in an orphanage, discovers that his benefactor was actually his biological father. To escape the shadow of his father’s family, he throws himself into a foreign war.  

On the desolate battlefield—where he has no reason to survive, no goals to pursue—one day he receives a letter, gentle as a spring breeze:   
“Hello, soldier whose name and face I do not know. I’m delighted that fate has connected us this way. I am a lady from a humble family living in the countryside with beautiful scenery. I’m not anyone remarkable, so I don’t have much to introduce myself with.”  

The noblewoman introduces herself as Lintrey. What begins as a chance pen pal relationship gradually becomes Demian’s only solace, and the woman beyond the letters becomes his first reason to want to live.  

Later, Demian is discharged after an unexpected accident. He travels to the address from the letters to find his pen pal, but…  

“That house burned down in a huge fire not long ago.”   
“If the Lintrey you’re talking about is the maid from that house, then she’s dead.”   

A burned mansion. Conflicting testimonies…  
Did Lady Lintrey ever really exist, or was it all a lie from the beginning?  

Confused and shaken, Demian clings to a faint hope that she cannot be dead and heads to the capital city of Nihiro to search for her.  

Will Demian be able to meet Lintrey again in that place?

And will he finally receive an answer to the words he never got to say?

Then one day, on her way home after catching her boyfriend of nine years cheating and breaking up with him, Jihye happens to meet a dokkaebi who is wandering in search of the Mountain Spirit. The dokkaebi makes her an offer: if she helps him find the Mountain Spirit, he will fix her eyes. With the hope of finally being able to live the ordinary life and enjoy the normal everyday moments she has always longed for, Jihye makes a deal with the dokkaebi. But there are beings watching the two of them from afar and from close by. What is the story tying together the dokkaebi and the Mountain Spirit, and was the meeting between Jihye and the dokkaebi really just a coincidence?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

description:
The Hero Andert.

A great swordsman who ended the Great War by sacrificing himself.
One of the rare heroes…

But he was actually a woman disguised as her dead younger brother.

That was me.

But…

“Huh?”

Did I just come back to life four years after my death? All I had was my body, so there was only one way to survive.

Becoming a maid.

“You’ve never worked as a maid before this, so what have you been doing all this time?”

“Jobless.”

“What motivated you to apply for this job?”

“Money.”

“What kind of mansion would you like to work in?”

“A mansion that is so hard to work in and so nasty that we don’t even know if it’ll be cleaned if we both work and die.”

“What kind of employer do you want?”

“A vicious employer that terrorizes their employees.”

That way I won’t get laid off since I’m the only one you can work with.

“…” The interviewer looked at me like I was crazy.

—

Here, I will start anew. Not as the Hero Andert or my deceased little brother.

But as the maid Daisy.

description:
Lucella, who lost her only sibling, her sister, was now raising her sister’s son, Lucian, on her own. One day, she realizes that this world was actually inside a book, and Lucian was destined to become a villain in the future. Worse, he will be a terrible villain who torments the protagonist and gets brutally killed! 

“I can’t let my precious nephew die!” 

To keep her promise to her sister and to save the nephew she loves, she decides to raise Lucian to be a good person instead of a villain. But then… 

“Auntie, I want you to marry the Marquis.”  As if raising him properly wasn’t hard enough, now he’s saying weird things! 

“My uncle might not be the best husband material, but… at least he looks decent.”  Even the original story’s heroine was seriously trying to set up a matchmaking meeting. 

“I agree with that opinion.”  And her uncle just nods along like it makes sense. 

“Sorry, but I won’t think about marriage until I raise Lucian properly.” 

“So, you mean… as long as Lucian is raised well, it’s okay?” 

“Th-That’s not what I—” 

“I understand.” 

Why is everyone looking so excited?!

description:
Ah, the headstrong Charlotte Augusta? She really doesn’t seem like an Augusta at all. There’s a reason she still has no suitors even after three seasons in society.

Charlotte Augusta, the third of the five sisters from the renowned Augusta family in British high society. Charlotte, who was treated like a black sheep among her beautiful sisters, causes a major scandal at a ball she attended—as usual—in search of a husband. And there, she meets a handsome man with a refined charm. Prince Leopold of the Kingdom of Holland, a handsome man visible only to Charlotte’s eyes, agrees to clean up the mess she made and help her find England’s finest suitor—in exchange for her help in locating his own body, the whereabouts of which are unknown. 

*“Don’t worry, Lady. You won’t lose out on anything. As you help me, you’ll end up meeting every single one of England’s most eligible bachelors.”*

And so, as the two of them put their heads together every dawn when Leopold’s spirit awoke, the closer they got to their goal, the more confused they became by the feelings welling up toward each other…

description:
Oh Ga-eun goes to a job interview, hoping to finally escape unemployment. But… she sat in the wrong seat. 

“Ms. Yoon Hye-jin, right?” 

“I’m Oh Ga-eun…?” 

It wasn’t a company interview. It was an interview to become someone’s bride. The man in front of her is Joo Seok-jin, the president of Jushin Retail— a man who’s currently “recruiting” a wife. 

“Today’s interview to find my wife is a secret.” 

She promises to keep it confidential and leaves— only to run into him again at a vacation spot she spent all her savings to visit. Then a headline suddenly breaks: 

[Chairman Joo Seok-jin to Marry This September] 

“What do you think about becoming my bride, Ms. Oh Ga-eun?” 

“Fine. But don’t you dare cut my salary or allowances.” 

And just like that, their contract marriage begins. 

Position: Fake wife 
Job: Daughter-in-law of a chaebol family 
Additional duty: Surviving the in-laws.

 She was only supposed to act like the troublesome third daughter-in-law— so why does the way that man looks at her feel so sincere? A contract marriage that started with a mistaken interview seat. It began as something fake… but can their feelings stay fake too?

description:
The year is 2001. At Yujung High School, known as a gathering place for troublemakers, a bloody battle rages daily between students vying for the top spot and the Disciplinary Committee trying to stop them. Just when it seemed he had finally taken over the infirmary and secured absolute power, a suspicious-looking, womanizing transfer student, Sin Jong-U, was already casually occupying the space.

Having fallen from the top spot to second place in just 13 minutes, Jin-Tae challenges Jong-U once again to reclaim the infirmary and his position as the top dog, but Jong-U seems to have some other ulterior motive...?

“But instead of washing rags… can’t you do something else?”     

Her startled gaze lifts straight to Dogyeol’s eyes. Gulp. Without realizing it, Sobom swallows hard, her throat tight with tension.     

“Oh my. Your face is really hot. Is it a battery issue?”     

He kneels down on one knee. Just as she lowers her eyes in unease, she meets Dogyeol’s gaze—he’s looking up at her with a playful smile.     

“I’d better check.”      

His smiling hand slowly lifts the hem of her maid outfit. Sobom flinches at the unexpected sensation, biting down hard on her lip.     

“Feels just like a human thigh…Was the battery slot here?”

title: Dissolve: His Last Choice
description:
< Dissolve: A film editing technique where one scene gradually overlaps another on the same screen as transition occurs. >

Song Hyunsoo, an unknown actor who makes a living as a bartender.
He gets cast in a famous director’s film and ends up acting alongside the nation’s famous actor, Yoon Juho.

He drinks only water that costs 400,000 won.
He replaces managers as casually as eating a meal.
—Yoon Juho, a man surrounded by countless rumors.

“Where do you live?”
“It’s okay. I can take the bus.”
“I asked where you live. I didn’t say I’d take you home.”
“…Bogwang-dong.”
“I will take you there.”

Though his words are mean, Hyunsoo becomes curious about the unexpectedly gentle side hidden in his past,
and a strange tension begins to form between the two.

“I fail to live up to expectations, leave people alone, hurt them… and every moment I’m reminded that I’m a defective product who only looks fine on the outside. When it comes to relationships, those are the only memories I have.”

But it doesn’t seem easy to conquer a prince who has lived his entire life as a top star…

The past he never even properly began to face fades away, and a new love approaches.
Change and growth to create a final love—and the final choice.

title: Gaemigul
description:
The filthy, vulgar den of crime: the Ant Hill. I was born and raised here—a pure-blood ant. 
Though in the end, I'm nothing more than an ordinary worker ant. 

Ants aren't allowed to escape. And maybe it was the price for dreaming of freedom... Instead of an ID, the only thing that came back was my friend, reduced to ashes in the incinerator. 

Just when I had resigned myself to everything, Jang Heejo, the true master of the Ant Hill, appeared before me. 

"So... do you want to make me yours?"

"My first time will be with the person I love."

Love? First time? Way too romantic to come from the mouth of a man who causes bloodshed every single day. 

"Even if it isn't love, I'm fine with that."

"We'll see..."

The tables turned in an instant.

title: Eunggeup Matseon
description:
I went on a blind date as a stand-in for my older sister… only to find out the man was my supervising professor at the university hospital. Jeong Dasom agreed to take her sister’s place on a blind date for a small allowance of 300,000 won. But her date turned out to be a professor in the Emergency Medicine Department at SJ University Hospital—the very place where she was about to start her residency! He was infamous in the ER for being cold and ruthless, and if he found out she was just a substitute, her hospital life would be over before it even began. “Since we’re both at a perfectly suitable age for marriage, I’d like us to seriously consider seeing each other. What do you think?” …Wait. Was that basically a proposal just now? No, that’s not the problem. Should I confess right now—“I’m not your actual blind date, I’m just a stand-in!”? Or should I just quietly run away? Just as her mind went into full panic mode, an emergency call came in, and the man rushed back to the hospital. Not long after, the two met again—this time as professor and resident. Will Dasom be able to keep the truth about the substitute blind date hidden until the end? A clumsy, soft-hearted resident, Jeong Dasom, tangled up in a fake blind date, and a so-called cold-blooded emergency medicine professor, Tae Kang-hyuk—who, for some reason, is gentle only with her. A heart-racing medical romance set in the emergency room!

Leekyeom mistakes him for the new manager of a security team, and Taejung allows the misunderstanding to continue while offering calculated kindness for his own purposes. However, drawn in by Leekyeom’s faint scent, Taejung begins to take an interest he never planned on having.

Though he approached him with hidden motives, even those motives begin to fade. Yeon Leekyeom, who is sick and tired of Taejung, the “thug”, yet cannot help but crumble in front of the gentleness he shows, finds himself drawn closer day by day…

Who Torments That Farmer Every Night?

description:
**[A 100-Night Challenge Between a Farmer and a Worm Asking to Share Yang Energy]**

The only occupants of a shabby, one-room thatched hut were the farmer Nongbu and a white dog. Nongbu made a living by renting land from a well-known local landlord, and after another long day of plowing his fields, he returned home and wrapped up his day.

*“Haah….”*

Exhausted from farm work, Nongbu fell into a deep sleep... But suddenly, a strange, moan-like sound echoed through the room. The odd thing was, he was the only person inside. Kicking off his worn blanket, the only one he owned, mended by the wife of his neighbor and only friend Gaecheol, the farmer twisted in distress.

*“Mm….”*

It was impossible to tell what was tormenting him. Soon, the ties of his thin undergarment came undone, exposing his bare skin. Tossing and turning across his bedding, the farmer broke out in a cold sweat, letting out soft moans again and again.

Just who is tormenting 22-year-old Hong Nongbu every night? To answer that, we must go back to the daytime, ninety-nine days earlier.

---

title: Mystic City

unknown.title: Mystic City: กับดักรักเมืองลวง

description:
Muju, a city brimming with fog, was created to emulate Las Vegas in Korea. Sahee, having wandered aimlessly, seeks refuge in this strange city, only to encounter Eundo, a man as cold and mysterious as the fog itself.     

“Shall I kill them?”     

“What?”     

“Those bastards just now. If you want, I'll take care of them.”     
He is a man exuding a dangerous aura, one that reminds her of the past she desperately fled. She should have pushed him away. After all, he was nothing more than the kind of thug she despised, merely wearing the guise of a benefactor.     

“If there’s anything you’d like to eat, I'll get it for you. Just pick something.”     

“Only a drink?”     

But Sahee couldn't comprehend the full extent of it. Like Persephone captivated by Hades, she never had a choice from the very beginning.     

“Because I have no intention of letting you go.”    

Everything had been meticulously orchestrated for her; it was an astonishing trap.

title: ASMR, Romance
description:
Do-Yun, a returning college student, is forced by financial circumstances to rent a room in a cheap apartment building rumored to be haunted. However, he is relieved to discover that what people mistook for ghostly noises were actually the erotic moans of the man next door… but the daily “moaning terror” leaves him sleepless night after night. Furious, Do-Yun goes to the next-door apartment to complain, but when he sees his neighbor Jay’s good looks and shy demeanor, he loses his nerve and simply gives him a mild warning before turning away. As Do-Yun turns away, he tears down a flyer stuck to his door and cuts his hand on the paper, letting out a faint moan… At that moment, Jay, the neighbor who had seemed so innocent, suddenly changes his demeanor, lunges at Do-Yun, and makes a crazy request: “Please, let me record that moan.”

 *“Excuse me! I’m obsessed with your moans—please let me record them—”*

A full-on perverted moaning ASMR live stream featuring two men from next door—care to tune in?

unknown.title: Do You Have a Favorite Dog?

description:
Seo-Kyung, who has had a crush on his childhood friend Jae-Ha for a long time, has lived his life believing that this love would never be reciprocated. Consumed by jealousy toward Jae-Ha, who was kind to everyone, Seo-Kyung even pretended to dislike him. Then one day, he came across a post on an anonymous college forum. 

*“Does anyone know the name of the guy working at the library starting at 1 PM on Fridays? He’s the textbook definition of a puppy face… He’s so handsome… If you know him, please send me a DM ㅜㅜ”*

Seo-Kyung, who didn’t even expect Jae-Ha, who turns heads wherever he goes, to notice him, falls asleep that night, in a fit of pique, imagining the childish fantasy that Jae-Ha might as well be a real dog. And when morning comes, an unidentified brown dog is sleeping right next to him. 

“No way… is this Cha Jae-Ha?”

Seo-Kyung’s desperate struggle to break the curse that turned his secret crush into a dog begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

description:
For 8 long years, I clung to a one-sided love, until I finally put an end to it.

He never once looked my way. Instead, I became the subject of whispered mockery and careless cruelty, wounds I carried in silence. Even so, I convinced myself that someday he would turn around and see me. Only now did I realize the truth. It wasn’t love. It was obsession.

So I made a decision. I would forget the Crown Prince. I would stop wounding myself over someone who never chose me and start seeking a happiness that belonged solely to me.

"This is the end. From now on, I’ll live for myself."

That was what I believed, until he appeared again, no longer the Crown Prince but the Emperor.

"What is my fiancée doing here?"

As though nothing had changed, he addressed me so naturally. The past I thought I had closed the door on stood before me once again, and the emotions I had carefully buried began to stir.

Why now? What does he want?

A woman determined to end her love, and a man who refuses to believe it ever ended.

Staring at the scars left behind by 8 years of unrequited devotion, I ask myself,

This time... can I truly let it go?

This man, so beautiful and elegant that Dong-Sik has never even seen his like on TV, takes Dong-Sik’s lighter and walks away. As Dong-Sik watches him go, he witnesses the man, who had been standing uneasily at the end of the breakwater, suddenly jump into the sea. Without a moment’s hesitation, Dong-Sik jumps into the sea after him. But in the pitch-black darkness, the man is nowhere to be found. Just as Dong-Sik is about to surface in the pitch-black sea where he can see nothing, something begins to pull at his ankle...

During his time in an orphanage, after being abandoned by his parents and unable to endure the abuse, he had run away on his own. When he finally managed to reunite with his father, the joy of their reunion was short-lived; his father took all the money Dong-Sik had saved and disappeared again. Dong-Sik then ended up working under a loan shark, taking on all sorts of dangerous jobs and narrowly escaping death on numerous occasions. Dong-Sik’s last memory was a plea: “Please let me be born into a wealthy family in my next life, so I can live without a single worry.” When he opened his eyes again, he found himself in a top-tier private hospital room—neither heaven nor hell. And in the mirror stood not Park Dong-Sik, but the man Dong-Sik had been trying to save. As Dong-Sik stood bewildered by this utterly incomprehensible phenomenon, another man appeared, volunteering to be his guardian. The man, who suddenly kissed him while asking, “How could you forget me?” was calling Dong-Sik “sister-in-law.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

It was enough money to live comfortably for the rest of my life. My debt-ridden commoner’s body reacted faster than my mind.

description:
A carriage more luxurious than I’ve ever seen, a mansion so big I couldn’t tell if it was a home or a castle. My seven-year-old life, spent cozily with my father in a rural village, changed forever when the immensely wealthy Count Travel finally tracked down his runaway second son.

My dad is a noble? I have a rich grandfather?!

My relatives didn’t give my father a warm welcome after his six-years absence; instead, they pierced him with cold, hostile glares. n that moment, strange scenes began to surface my mind like a torrential rainstorm.

Berry, you must be careful of the relatives. Travel is a den of beasts, all hunting for the position of family head.

Lady Berry! News has arrived… Young Master Reitan has been killed in action!

Seven years old, ten years old, sixteen years old…
They were all me, yet they were memories I didn’t remember.
And in every single one of those memories, my father met a meaningless, tragic death.

***

This… this can’t possibly be real.

“Head Butler, did you recently purchase a large amount of stock in an ink company that’s about to go bankrupt?”
“That company would never go bust… Wait, how did you know I bought those stocks?”

Ack! That was exactly right, too!

If these memories are real, then this time, I will save my father no matter what.

But I can’t do this alone.
I need an ally who will be my greatest pillar of support.
Fortunately, there is a hidden gem that only I know of.
Someone who looks like a mud-covered pebble right now, so no one thinks to keep their guard up.

“Crown Prince Theon Phil Boltman.”

My first plan is to make that young boy my ally.

description:
Dong-i, the daughter of a drunkard cobbler, grew up hearing nothing but the words, 'If only you had never been born.' She spent her days sobbing in silence, desperately praying: 'Please, let me be loved just once before I die, so that I can be someone precious to another.' 

One day, while fleeing from greedy thugs in the mountains, she discovers the body of Seol Hwa-yeon, the fiancée of Lee Heun, the notorious 'Evil King' of Hyeongju. Remembering the rumor that the King had never seen his bride's face in their political marriage, Dong-i looks at the woman's expensive silk clothes and jewelry. 'From this moment on, I will rise from the lowest depths to the highest heights. I can finally be someone loved, someone precious.' 

With trembling, frostbitten hands, she reaches for Seol Hwa-yeon’s identification tag.

On a rainy night, a man stabbed with a knife appears at her door.    
“You. What the hell are you doing?”     
“Let me stay here. Just for a few days. Until I have the strength to find another place.”     
“How can I trust that you won’t hurt me again?”

“Aren’t you worried I might kill you?”     
“You won’t.”     
“Because you don’t want to become a murderer.”    
A man with no expectations left of life, yet still desperately clinging to survival — Chae Soo-ho. In him, Yeon Harin sees the face of someone she thought she had long forgotten, someone she believed she had erased.     
“…Behave yourself, so I don’t have to clean up a corpse tomorrow morning.”

title: The Way to You
description:
In the winter of her thirty-second year, Heejae's husband's mistress became pregnant. 

Overwhelmed by shock, Heejae suffered a stillbirth, losing the child she had conceived after a decade with her unfaithful husband. 

"I will never love you, even if I die... even if I'm reborn." 

She jumped off the rooftop of her husband's company, and when she opened her eyes, she had returned ten years to the past – to before she met Baek Doyoung, that man. With nothing left but the desire for revenge for her tragically lost child, Heejae heads to a blind date, intent on personally ruining Doyoung's life. However... Doyoung's actions are strangely different from the past, giving her an unfamiliar feeling. A scar on his wrist that the Doyoung she knew didn't have, a face identical to his, yet a gentle demeanor – everything about him is entirely unfamiliar. 

"Who... who exactly is this man?"

title: Jeonso
description:
Sora's seven-year-old birthday. A small mistake turned into a raging fire, consuming everything. Even the relationship between the two good friends was no exception. 

"Hakbin... I'll always be by your side. I won't let you be lonely. I'll be your mother, your sister, your friend... I'll do whatever you want. I promise." 

Just like her childhood promise, Sora silently cared for him, tolerated his childish antics, and repaid the "debt" in her heart. What kept her from the suffocating cycle of guilt was the hope that she could distance herself from Hakbin once she became an adult. She thought she would be able to break free from him and find her own life... 

"I think you're not coming to your senses." 

"..." 

"But now you know, right? Who is important to you?" 

"..." 

"Keep doing this from now on. I'm the one you need to save. You must always look only at me so I don't go wrong." 

Hot tears flowed from the corners of her eyes, holding him in. Her vision blurred, and her breath caught in her throat. Hak-bin pressed his forehead against hers, leaving her speechless. 

"You're responsible for that, aren't you?" 

Hak-bin's words stabbed her heart like a sharp dagger. Cold blood flowed from her heart, and her breath soon took on a burnt scent. 

"You're mine, aren't you?"

description:
[Sex Practice? I’ll Help You.]

“Let’s stop. Us.”

Those were the words my lover said to me as I lay there catching my breath after sex. Even if a sudden downpour had fallen from a clear sky, I think I would have been less shaken than I was in that moment.

“Why? What brought this on all of a sudden?”  
“Sex with you isn’t fun.”

This is already the third time I’ve been dumped for such an absurd, bewildering reason. I’ve gone past emptiness and sadness and started wondering if there really is something wrong with me.

“Hey, Seohyun. What does it… actually mean… to be good at it?”  
“Excuse me? Good at what?”  
“…Sex. I was thinking of trying to practice on my own, at least.”

It was something I blurted out while drunk, half out of spite. I felt wronged, but I was also genuinely curious. Just how amazing is the sex everyone else is having?

“I can help you.”  
“Huh?”

But something feels off. As Seohyun quietly listens to my worries, his eyes seem filled with heat. Is that just because I’ve had too much to drink?

“I said I’ll help you. With that practice.”

title: How to Break a Jinx
description:
Ace pitcher Kang Jihwan and star batter Baek Hwigyeom built their friendship around a single ball since childhood.
After graduating high school, they both successfully went pro through the rookie draft, and their youth seemed to be on a smooth, unstoppable path… At least until their seventh year, when Hwigyeom fell into a hellish slump he never could have imagined.

Dating? No. Drinking or smoking? Absolutely not. Going out? Only a strict home–stadium routine. Even self-pleasure? Completely cut off, all in on training. And yet his performance kept plummeting, his pride hitting rock bottom. A man ruled by superstitions, sensitive even to the smallest pre-game routine, Hwigyeom was driven mad by a slump that only deepened without any clear reason.

Frustrated, he calls up Jihwan - now on a different team - and they go out for drinks. Drinking recklessly like nothing matters, Hwigyeom ends up completely wasted… When he comes to his senses, he finds himself lying in bed with his best friend, Jihwan. And they’ve already… done *that*.

The next day, too embarrassed to even make eye contact, Hwigyeom heads to the stadium and is given a rare pinch-hitting opportunity. And in that moment - a walk-off three-run home run. A dramatic comeback that makes his seven-year slump seem meaningless.

Leaving him with just one conclusion:  
…Did what happened last night become his new superstition?

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13927088)

He then had business cards printed with “Farmer” as his occupation and handed them out to everyone he met. He was worried that the neighbors, curious about his move to the countryside, might bombard him with annoying questions or gossip.

Lee Sam-Tak handed out those business cards. And once he did, the word “farmer” printed on those cards became the name the locals used to address him. That’s right—it became his proper name. Even if Lee Sam-Tak is clumsy at farming and ruins the crops, people still call him “Farmer”—as if mocking him. Even when Lee Sam-Tak runs around the mountains day in and day out with a shotgun, claiming he’s hunting animals that harm the crops, people still call him “Farmer.” 

No, no. What if—just what if—for real! Let’s say Lee Sam-Tak says he’s “just taking a break.” Even then, they’d still call him “Farmer.” Those villagers would. Because that’s what Lee Sam-Tak wants.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Rawongi
description:
In a world where gods and humans coexist, there is a land called Rawon (羅園). The gods here survive by feeding on the reverence of humans, and in return use that power to protect them. Humans, meanwhile, live their lives under the gods’ grace, bound together in a “cycle of reverence and blessing.”

Yusa, the river god of Cheongyugang, has refused human reverence for nearly a century after losing his beloved human disciple, Tan’eo. Whenever he comes close to losing his divinity and fading into a lesser creature, he barely prolongs his fragile existence by borrowing divine power through “hapshin,” a union with the mountain god Gaho, who secretly harbors feelings for him.

Meanwhile, Dajin, the son of a great general whose entire clan was slaughtered by an evil god, longs to become an “Inje” — a human emperor chosen by the gods — for the sole purpose of revenge. Confident in his exceptional martial skill, he asks to become Gaho’s disciple, but Gaho sees through the vengeance consuming his heart and rejects him. Driven into despair by the belief that the gods abandoned both his parents and himself, Dajin ultimately throws himself into the Cheongyu River.

Wishing that no more humans connected to him would die, Yusa saves Dajin by passing on the last of his remaining divinity through a kiss, exhausting his own strength in the process. When Dajin awakens, he dismisses Yusa’s actions as mere whimsy and lashes out in anger. Demanding that Yusa take the divine power back, he impulsively kisses him in return.

In that fleeting moment of contact, the two share each other’s wounds and true feelings, unintentionally forming a master-disciple contract. Through “hapshin,” the act of exchanging divine power, Yusa gains the vitality needed to survive, while Dajin obtains the strength he needs for revenge.

A god unable to escape the scars of the past, and a human willing to risk his life for vengeance. As Rawon’s greatest competition, the Jeseonje (帝選祭), approaches for the first time in a hundred years, their desperate yet sensual tale of salvation begins.

---

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14030451), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/5469002040)

title: Not a Guardian at All
description:
"It's my first time. So please, teach me, okay?"

"I've told you time and again that I think of you as family." 

"I don't know anything about that. I just... I want to do it with you, Executive Director." 

As she waited for Sangheon's reply, Dajeong swallowed hard. Sangheon's gaze fell upon Dajeong's glistening, red lips. 

"You want to do it too, don't you? I know it's not just me."

Looking down at the blushing Dajeong, Sangheon thought to himself: If a child wants to play with fire, you have to let them touch the flame for them to come to their senses. He would teach her the truth that the world is not as easy as she thinks. 

"You're the one who started this." 

It was a truly arrogant and foolish judgment.

When Jae-Yeong returns to his neighborhood, he is greeted by Do-Ha. Do-Ha, who used to be a timid younger brother who cried at the drop of a hat, had grown tall enough to look down on Jae-Yeong. But the joy is short-lived, as Do-Ha begins to gradually disrupt Jae-Yeong’s daily life.

Do-Ha keeps bringing back memories of a past Jae-Yeong had tried to forget. Is Do-Ha Jae-Yeong’s salvation, or his trial?

title: Broken Engagement Scandal
description:
“Let’s call off the engagement.” 

Chihun lets out a hollow laugh, his eyes wandering aimlessly in the air. His dark gaze fixed on Seoyeon, heightening the tension around them. Just like her newly cropped hair, Seoyeon left Chihun without a shred of regret. However, after three years without contact, Chihun suddenly reappears before her. 

“You’re different from the Jin Seoyeon I knew.” 

“But why do I feel like this is your true self?” 

“Why do I feel like you’ve been deceiving me?” 

As he speaks, his eyes seem to glisten with unshed tears. Looking haggard as if he hasn’t slept for days, Seoyeon finds herself unable to look away from him. 

“Sleep with me, Jin Seoyeon.” 

And so, once again, Seoyeon finds herself unable to refuse his proposal.

description:
Seo Yu-ju, the owner of Cafe Sallang, is kind to everyone except for the Taoists.
Do Kang-hyun is a fourth-generation chaebol with a foul mouth but a good heart.

Kang-hyun, who went to retrieve a painting by an unknown artist at his grandfather's request, meets Yu-ju, who is determined not to let her grandmother's painting be taken away.

"Why do you dislike me?"

Yu-ju's coldness causes Kang-hyun to change his plan to just buy the painting and return, and he seizes the opportunity to even move into her house.

"Hey, Do Kang-hyun. It's just a hand touch..."
"A hand touch? You kneaded someone's body like dough, and you say it was just a hand touch?"
"When did I ever knead dough—"
"You did! Seo Yu-ju, have your fill with your own hands!"

title: Yareutan Oppa Chingu
description:
A handsome face and broad shoulders. A man who is prickly to the world but gentle only to her. Yet, he still sees her as just a child. Tonight, Jena is determined to make Woo Tae-kyung fall for her, one way or another. 

"Doing this in front of a man leads to trouble."    

"Even for you, Oppa?"     
Tae-kyung’s expressionless eyes finally curved into a slight smile. The corners of his mouth rose slowly and meaningfully.    

"Yeah, me too." 

*

"I told you I wouldn't be able to handle you."   
  
"I also said I wouldn't be able to stop halfway."    

It was on a completely different level from what she had seen in her dreams. Seeing him pulse and move with such intensity, Jena swallowed hard without realizing it. This... This is... 

"It's... it's even bigger..." 

At that moment, Tae-kyung’s brow furrowed deeply. 

"What?" 

The gentle adult who had been coaxing her was gone. 

"Our little Jena has grown quite bold. Who exactly are you comparing me to right now?"

title: About Impure Obsession
description:
"Look only at me, where I can see you."      

"How would you like to attend a dinner as my partner, Ms. Yun Ha-ru?" 

They were just an ordinary employee and customer—at least, until she dropped her notebook at his house. 

"Honestly, I'm uncomfortable and find it difficult to be involved with you, Mr. Cho Jae-yun."    

"What should I do? I have no intention of letting you go."    

Ha-ru thought everything would end once she accepted his proposal and got her notebook back. But hearing his words, which sounded like he needed her, and feeling a warmth and consideration she had never received before, her fragile heart kept drifting toward him. Even though she knew she was nothing more or less than a partner to this man, it was like a swamp she could neither reject nor escape.    

"I like you."     

"I've come to like you, Director." Even so, she confessed to the man who said he didn't know or believe in love. "If only I could go back to before I liked you... I wouldn't be in this much pain." 

Without knowing that she would regret this day for a long, long time.

description:
The man who raised me as his own daughter was murdered. Deciding to use my save&reload ability, I turned back time to a previous safe point. The problem is, out of my four time slots, he’s only alive in the one where I’m seven. Welp, it is what it is. Repeating some life is no biggie, so let’s start over. Elysion, giving off a weird vibe, pulled me aside. He’d been a close friend even pre-reset. Is this happening? 

[Overwriting Time Slot 1 with current point.] 

“I love you, Tania. I’ve liked you for a long time.” 

“Ah, I’m finally getting a confession…!” 

Overcome with excitement, I immediately loaded the save point so I could hear his confession again. 

[Time Slot 1 Loaded.] 

[Time Slot 1 Loaded.] 

[Time Slot 1 Load…] 

[Time Slot 1 …….] 

I’m not sure how many times I replayed his confession. Elysion’s face turned so red that it looked about ready to burst; he parted his lips with a troubled look. 

“Tania. If you want, I can tell you as many times as you’d like, but could you at least give me an answer to my confession first?” 

“What…?” 

Shockingly, he remembered everything I did. Instantly, everything I’d done in front of him flashed through my mind. Like, I would often look at his face, muttering to myself about how handsome he was. And how every time I wanted to see him, I would go up to him and touch him, making him distressed. And most importantly, how I had just turned back the clock by twelve freaking years just because I wanted to. I really didn’t think he would end up remembering all of that.

description:
I, Robellyn Dines, was reincarnated into the world of a satisfying revenge novel.

The problem was that I’d become the villainess doomed to be destroyed by that very revenge.

After having an affair with the Crown Prince, who was supposed to be the female lead’s husband, and committing countless evil deeds, her fate in the original story was to die beneath the guillotine.

But there’s no way I’m going to live like that.

“Fine. I’ll get rid of that useless excuse for a husband before anything even starts!”

All I had to do was push the original female lead and male lead together and escape this cursed storyline for good.

And I succeeded.

I even managed to prevent the moment that originally caused the female lead and Crown Prince Ian to fall in love.

But…

‘Why the hell is this man sleeping next to me?’

By accident, I ended up spending the night with the Crown Prince himself.

At this rate, things are no different from the original story! 

Panicking, I fled the scene immediately. After all, Ian was infamous for being a playboy. I’m sure he’ll forget a one-night mistake soon enough.

—

“You’re the one. The woman who slept with me and ran away.”

The moment I noticed Ian’s hand blocking the door, I realized something had gone terribly wrong.

“N- no, I think you’ve mistaken me for someone else—”

“Really?”

At my desperate denial, Ian only curled his lips into a dangerous smile. With slow, unhurried movements, he began undoing the buttons of his shirt one by one.

“Then shall we confirm it?”

“C- confirm what exactly?”

“Whether or not you’re the woman from that night. If we reenact it, you’ll remember soon enough.”

With those words, the final button of his shirt came undone.

description:
Cha Seung-jo is the young leader who propelled Muyoung Hotel to the number one spot in the industry. He is a man for whom the path he walks becomes the road, and his will becomes the law. He has never been a subordinate since the day he was born, but there was once a single person who brought him absolute humiliation...

"Your hands are slow. Shoveling. Can't you do it properly?"

During his active military service, his platoon leader made him shovel like crazy: Seo Eun-jae.

'Platoon Leader, if you ever see me in the real world, your jaw will drop. You'll think, "How did I dare order someone like that around?"'

She was so stubborn and upright that his petty cheekiness never worked on her at all. Who would have thought that very platoon leader would suddenly appear right before his eyes—and as his secretary, no less!

"I will do my best with my assigned duties. This time, as your secretary."

From that day on, things he never expected in his life began to happen.

"Want to sleep with me?"    
"Ah, you don't even want a meal? Do you hate everything that starts with the letter 'S'?"

And the most shocking, bolt-from-the-blue event of all...

"Then let's just kiss."

...He ended up doing some crazy "shoveling" after all.

title: Subjugation
description:
What if Admiral Yi Sun-sin had not died at the Battle of Noryang? 
Yi Sun-sin is struck down by enemy fire at Noryang, but against all odds he survives, and the seven-year Imjin War finally comes to an end. However, King Seonjo feels a pathological jealousy and crushing sense of pressure toward Yi, who has become the people’s hero and the symbol of Joseon’s victory. In secret collusion with key figures of the Westerners faction, Seonjo has Yi Sun-sin secretly arrested, brands him a traitor, and sentences him to a brutal death. The male members of Yi’s family are executed or exiled, while the women are dragged off as government slaves and meet tragic ends. Yi Sun-sin is ultimately put to death by dismemberment inside an abandoned palace, and even his corpse is burned until nothing remains.
Yet, astonishingly, Yi Sun-sin suddenly finds himself sent back more than thirty years into the past, to his own youth. From that day on, he begins to move in secret: not only to stop the Japanese invaders who will one day ravage Joseon and massacre its people, but also to exact retribution on the future Seonjo who will annihilate him and his family. At the same time, he lays grand plans to conquer Japan, the Jurchen tribes, and even Ming China, and starts carrying them out one step at a time.

I was reincarnated as a supporting villain character. A tr*shy princess who was obsessed with the big brother of the cute heroine and eventually poisoned the heroine to destroy her. Because I’m leaving to enjoy my dreams, hopes, and money in a seaside villa with beautiful waves! Everyone should be happy too! I thought so… …I thought you were really dead. I… His golden eyes that contained me were engulfed in emotions I couldn’t read. I felt like I was going to drown just by looking at it. …It felt like an endless nightmare, Tia. Please don’t disappear in front of me like that anymore, while whispering earnestly. I was at a loss for words to say to him, who grabbed my hand as if tying me to go nowhere. And… It’s okay to hate my brother! But, don’t hate the duke’s money! …The cute heroine who gives me the key to the underground safe containing all the treasures… Is everything bothering you? Then choose me instead. Don’t let it bother yourself, Duchess. I’ll be by your side anytime, anywhere. Even the second older brother of the female protagonist, who always looked at me like a thorn in his eyes, became a bit strange. What is wrong here?

description:
Yeon-woo and her family of three live in an old, low-rise apartment building on the outskirts of Seoul.
Her mother is always busy with work at a restaurant, and her older brother, a high school senior, is on edge preparing for the college entrance exam.
To make matters worse, even her one and only best friend moves away, leaving Yeon-woo feeling like a loner.

Then one day, she meets a friend in her dreams who looks exactly like her—a girl named Maeum (Heart).
From that moment, Yeon-woo's life begins to change little by little.
She becomes friends with Sol-i, who lives in the same building but was always awkward with her, and she starts opening her heart to neighbors she once viewed with prejudice.

description:
Si-Yul, who had worked hard to save up a security deposit for rent so he could leave the orphanage and live on his own, was swindled out of his savings. To raise the money again, at the urging of his best friend and fellow orphanage resident, he reluctantly takes on a dangerous, high-paying part-time job delivering drugs. He begged and pleaded for his life and barely managed to escape that situation, but it wasn’t long before he was caught again. As if by a twist of fate, during their third encounter, he ends up owing him a huge debt.

*“You say you don’t have any money, so what else can I do? You’ll have to pay me back with your body.”*

Their relationship began with a casual remark that sounded like a threat but wasn’t quite one, but before he knew it, a strange chemistry began to develop between them…

*“What if I refuse?”
“I’ll probably make things a little more annoying for you than they are now, Kwon Si-Yul.”
“Are you saying you’ll torment me?”
“I’m saying we’ll see each other more often.”*

But his plans are completely upended when he meets Ezra, a cowboy of mixed Native heritage. 

*"Me? I'm your humble slave, Master."* 

Claiming to be Gerald's slave, Ezra constantly crosses boundaries and provokes him at every turn. Yet in the face of Ezra's relentless attention, Gerald's heart begins to race once more. 

*"This is all his fault for getting me so worked up."* 

One man has lost everything and wishes to end his life. The other is determined to keep him alive—and by his side. Thus begins a precarious romance on the wasteland.

"You ate it. So, how about we have a little chat now?" 

Just like that, her life is mortgaged to a villain over one piece of bread. The man who gave her the bread turns out to be not just any villain, but the guild master — the big boss himself. Somehow knowing about her special ability of X‑ray vision (clairvoyance), he tracks her down and proposes a suspicious deal: 

"I give you food, you do the work. Not a bad trade, is it?" 

"Can I sleep somewhere warm? I won't go if you hit me." 

"Of course. Why would I hit something this tiny? I'll throw in gold coins too." 

"Deal! But are you going to eat that bread in your pocket? Give it to me." 

He's a bad guy, no matter how you look at it — but at least he won't make her beg for scraps and starve her as the orphanage director did. So she takes his hand. 

"Newbie. May I touch your cheek just once?" 

"One bryn per touch. That's 100 won." 

"That's WAY too cheap! I'd hand over my entire paycheck, ma'am!" 

"I was joking." 

She thought she just had to do her assigned jobs and that would be that — but the guild members' affection for her is suspiciously, overwhelmingly excessive. Then, on her first failed mission, the boss saves her from serious injury. 

"Boss, I still haven't succeeded yet." 

She said this while dangling from his side. 

"Does that matter? Are you hurt or not?" 

"I'm not hurt."

title: Neo Gateun Geon
description:
Jeong Yi-an, who has spent his 34 years dating only women, harbours a desire to sleep with a man just once. Then, at a high school reunion he attended by chance, he meets Kim Su-hyuk.

With his tousled hair, black horn-rimmed glasses, checked shirt, large frame and taciturn demeanour—seeing that he was exactly the same as ever, he felt a sense of warmth, whilst also thinking that if Kim Su-hyeok were to be his one-night stand, it might actually be quite alright.

*“Can we meet again sometime?”  
“Is that really necessary?”  
“Is it because I wasn’t good enough?”  
“Not exactly. Just one night. It wasn’t bad, was it?”*

However, sleeping with him wasn’t as thrilling as Yi-an had imagined. Just as he was about to dismiss it as a one-night fling, Su-hyeok unexpectedly got in touch first.

*“I can promise you it’ll be different this time. …I’ve been practising a lot.”  
“I’m just asking, just in case. You don’t actually like me or anything, do you?”  
“No.”  
“Right. See you again.”*

Clearly, at first, it had been nothing more than a new thrill in his monotonous daily life. Yet, as his meetings with Su-hyeok continued, laughter, joy and a tingling sense of excitement began to accompany them, and the bond between them—which had spanned sixteen years—began to take on a slightly different form…

title: The Manor Awaits Spring
description:
“I will reclaim the honor that was trampled beneath your feet.”

After seven years of isolation, her unjust prison sentence finally comes to an end.

April Lunos lost her parents and her family’s honor as the price for trying to punish the fiancé who betrayed her.

Now, she is determined to take her revenge. But what awaits her beyond prison is not freedom…

It is another fabricated accusation.

“Arrest April Lunos. She is the prime suspect in the series of murders committed over the past three years.”

A serial murder case… pinned on someone who spent those very years behind bars?

Amid this absurd accusation, she comes face to face with Vijin Deus—the younger brother of her former fiancé and her childhood friend.

Why has Vijin come to the estate?

And can April clear her name and restore the spring her family once lost?

title: Love Recycling
description:
Lim Mun-Yeong runs into his high school first love, Yeon Hae-Jeong, in an unexpected place. And not just anywhere—as an executive at a major corporation and a janitor at that same company. It’s been ten years since he gave up on his unrequited love. Whether Hae-Jeong recognized Mun-Yeong, who was hiding his name and pretending not to know him or not, Hae-Jeong drags him around, making him do odd jobs under all sorts of childish pretexts. Although Hae-Jeong’s strange behavior, as if he somehow remembered him, made him uncomfortable, Mun-Yeong didn’t care because he no longer had any feelings for him.

*“You don’t still like me, do you, Lim Mun-Yeong?”*

That is, until he heard those words from Hae-Jeong.

description:

Then one day, she is chosen by the cult leader as a 'Candidate for the Female Christ.' It is a holy mission to conceive a messiah who will save everyone. Believing this, Suryeon heads to the training room to follow God's will. However, what awaited her was the completely different face of the once-gentle Father Kwon Hyuk. 

"Sister, you have no right to refuse." 

The touch she believed to be salvation gradually turns into commands, and the mission she believed to be faith slowly transforms into total submission. Even amidst fear and guilt, Suryeon finds herself relying on Kwon Hyuk's words, clinging to the false tenderness he offers, and slowly losing her sense of self.

title: Jeamjincheongyeong
description:
Born beneath the ominous fate of the Heavenly Killing Star, destined to bring bloodshed wherever he walked, he refused to draw his sword, fearing the calamity it would bring upon the world. Though he knew the future, he chose to avert his eyes. But the price of his indifference was devastating. His clan was annihilated. His family was slaughtered. Only at death's door did he finally grasp the truth. Heaven does not punish the wicked. Karma does not exist. Justice is nothing more than a fantasy the weak cling to. The moment that realization dawned upon him, a forbidden scripture appeared before his eyes...

*"Sutra of Vanquishing Darkness and Rending the Heavens."*

A heaven-defying scripture born from the accumulated grudges of mankind, heaven, and earth.

*"If heaven refuses to pass judgment... then I shall do it myself."*

Having embraced the darkness, he returned as the Ruler of Darkness, vowing to punish every sin and bring down the sword of judgment upon this rotten world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“Let’s Make Them Mistake a Ruined World for a Game” Kim Jinwoo, a game director, was one day summoned to another world called “Arsilan.” After struggling through a harsh life, he eventually rose to become an archmage. However, Arsilan was on the brink of destruction due to entities known as “Erosion.” Jinwoo, who came from Earth, was the only one immune to Erosion. But even as an archmage, facing countless Erosions alone within the short span of three years was impossible. “I suppose I want to let everything go and rest now.” Just as Jinwoo gave up on everything and emptied his mind, he became a Transcendent. Through the “Gate of Souls,” an absolute authority he obtained upon becoming a Transcendent, Jinwoo gained the ability to travel between Earth and Arsilan. Using the Gate of Souls, he began summoning Earthlings—who were also immune to Erosion—to Arsilan, making them believe it was a game and having them fight against the Erosion. Thus began the project known as the “Arsilan Saga Project.”

description:
Asha has spent her days working tirelessly as a public official in charge of maintaining peace and security on Earth. But one day, due to a malfunction in a warp machine, she ends up arriving on an unknown planet.

Hee-su is caught enjoying herself with the toy, leading them to finally face their true wedding night. 

“Just what kind of book did you read to be like this...? Ah!”

“It must be one of those you enjoy reading.” 

Gang San gently strokes her inner thighs to ease her tension. 

“Should I suckle, or should I touch you?” 

“My dear husband!” 

Hee-su couldn't blame her young husband, who confessed he had studied up so he wouldn't seem inexperienced. The 'Required Reading After Marriage' was no longer just for women.

title: Perfect Error
description:
Ji Sun-Jeong knows exactly how cruel the world can be, especially for an omega scraping by at the absolute bottom. But nothing prepares him for the night he steps into a dark alley and watches the city’s most beloved billionaire philanthropist, Beom Seong-Heon, brutally beat a man half to death. Disgusted by the alpha’s saintly facade, Sun-Jeong decides to leverage the secret in order to secure his freedom. Surprisingly, Seong-Heon easily plays along, opening his wallet and pulling Sun-Jeong into his orbit. But Seong-Heon isn't without his own reasons. Both believe they hold the leash in this toxic game of mutual exploitation, but as their cold-blooded transaction spirals into a breathless attraction, the line between hunter and prey begins to vanish...

title: 100 Days of Nahong
description:
Dodo, the legendary tycoon cat of Dodo Department Store who inherited a fortune worth hundreds of billions. Kidnapped by a mysterious conspiracy and facing imminent death, he meets a witch and transforms into the stunningly beautiful "Nahong" ! However, the penalty of the magic was too harsh.

[A 100-day time limit, and nine lives.]

She went to rescue his grandmother, but the mansion had already been taken over by fake cats, and the one who saved Nahong from this crisis was Baek-Il, a security guard with a cat allergy. Nahong reveals her true nature as a shopping-addicted cat by swiping Baek-Il's credit card, and Baek-Il volunteers to be a tyrannical butler to tame this parasitic feline…! But to Nahong, Baek-Il is not just a simple human male. He is the one and only "precious butler" in the world who gave her the name "Nahong" !

“I will protect my grandmother and my butler Baek-Il no matter what, meow!”

From the suspicious movements of Dodo Department Store CEO Seol Chil-Guk to the appearance of Do Jun-Young, a mysterious cat killer targeting Nahong's life! Will Na-hong be able to save her grandmother before her nine lives run out and survive forever by the side of her one and only butler, Baek-Il? An unimaginable 100-day survival cohabitation romance with a cat more human than humans!

title: Hwansang-eui Love Line
description:
*“I really like this actor, you know.”*

Oh Yoonsang has been cast in N-flix Korea’s new drama, ‘Aftermath’. His character’s love interest is Jeong Do-hwan, a genius actor from the independent film scene whom he has secretly admired.

However, when they actually meet, he turns out to be a man who is completely impossible to figure out…?! Yoonsang, a hopeless romantic, finds himself completely at the mercy of Do-hwan—a free spirit who is playful yet serious, affectionate yet rude—rendering his nickname “Prince Alpha” utterly meaningless.

Do-hwan seems to harbour feelings yet never quite crosses the line. Even whilst playing arch-enemies on screen, the moment they turn their backs, he asks Yoonsang out on a date. Yoonsang plays the role of Do-hwan’s Omega, but in reality, pheromones have no effect on him. Love over defiance and pride! Will he be able to win the heart of this impregnable acting genius?

Yoonsang may have the reputation of a Hollywood Casanova, but he’s determined to make Do-hwan beg for him!

title: Bravo Youth Beer
description:
"Hire me. Business will boom if you hire someone with a face like mine."     

A suspicious new employee arrives at a shabby pub. He lives in a tiny studio apartment, yet he carries himself like a prince who owns the world. Why is he so confident despite constantly making trivial mistakes? Ji-woo, the pub manager, can't help but be bothered by him.      

"Noona, did you see that guy's car? It's a supercar worth over a billion won."      

As expected, he's strange and suspicious. Ji-woo doesn't want to admit she's attracted to him, but he keeps provoking her with his playful tone. 

"I told you, everything I have is on the larger side."     
"How could you possibly understand a body that even I don't fully understand?"    

Then, one day, he kisses her with a gaze of unfathomable depth. 

"Date me for a month. Properly." 

A strange secret romance begins with a suspicious man. Will she be able to end it safely after a month?
